subject: [RFC PATCH 26/57] mm/collapse: give collapse_single_pmd() the range to work on

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the collapse_single_pmd() function to accept a range instead of deriving it from its start point. The function is updated to pass the end of the range as an argument to both the scan and collapse operations, which already support partial tables. This change prepares for scanning VMAs that span less than a whole table and does not introduce any functional changes.
